title: Why AI Sometimes Thinks It's Still Last Year
topic: A model's knowledge freezes at its training cutoff; it only knows today's date if the app quietly pastes it in.

whyCare: Everyone has seen an AI get the year wrong; only small Shorts (3.8K) explain it.
